subject: PO workflow, monthly reconciliation window, and prepay discount conditions
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@procurewell.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap.procure@procurewell.com>, Procurement Legal <contracts@procurewell.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Billing cadence, PO fields, and prepay discount questions

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — team is excited. Procurement has a few operational constraints we need to confirm before issuing a PO:

- PO formatting: our ERP requires the vendor tax ID and contract reference (Contract#: PW-2026-118) to appear in the invoice header.
- Invoicing cadence: we prefer a single consolidated monthly statement (one invoice for all usage in the month) rather than weekly invoices. Can Redwood support that and still include per-subscription line items?
- Net terms: standard is Net45 for our suppliers. We can discuss Net30 if necessary, but we would need an approved exception.
- Prepay/annual discount: we are considering an annual prepay for a commit that would trigger a volume discount. Please outline the minimum commit, how discounts are applied on invoices, and whether prepay can be split across cost centers (we have two AP remittance addresses).

I attached our standard invoice template for reference. Also looped AP and Legal for any compliance/contract questions.

Can you confirm feasibility and any paperwork you need from our side?

Thanks,
Lina Gomez
Head of Procurement, ProcureWell
lina.gomez@procurewell.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: ProcureWell_invoice_template.xlsx (xls)

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@procurewell.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing cadence, PO fields, and prepay discount questions

Hi Lina — great to hear from you and glad the demo landed well. Short answers up front: yes on monthly consolidated statements with per-line detail, yes on adding Contract# and tax ID to the invoice header, and we can support split remittance to two AP addresses. Net45 is fine from our side, though our standard hosted terms default to Net30 so we'll capture the Net45 exception in the SOW/PO.

On prepay discounts: we offer tiered discounts for annual prepay (3% at $150k, 6% at $350k, 10% at $750k annual commitment). Prepay can be split across cost centers but we need a single master PO and an allocation schedule so our billing system maps lines to the correct GL codes.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa, can you confirm how we encode Contract# and vendor tax ID in Redwood invoices and whether our billing system can emit the two-remittance fields Lina referenced?
- Ben, can you prepare a draft SOW that includes the Net45 exception and the prepay discount tiers?
- Lina, thanks for the template — I'll upload it to our billing ops and circulate a sample invoice for sign-off.

I attached Redwood's invoice template and a short sample of how split remittance looks.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 628-555-0212

Attachment: Redwood_invoice_template_v3.pdf (pdf)

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: lina.gomez@procurewell.com, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:46:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Billing cadence, PO fields, and prepay discount questions

Thanks — looping in finance/ops and tax. Quick operational notes from billing ops:

- We can generate a consolidated monthly statement that includes per-subscription and per-usage line items. The one caveat is that for very large usage spikes we may emit an interim invoice; we will note that in the SOW as an "exception invoice" for overage events.
- Vendor tax ID and Contract# are supported fields in our invoice header. Please confirm ProcureWell's exact tax ID string and how you want the Contract# formatted (e.g., PW-2026-118 or PW 2026/118).
- Split remittance: our system supports two remittance addresses but requires a primary remittance address on the invoice and a remittance note for the secondary. If ProcureWell needs two separate payable invoices to two addresses, we will need a master PO and two internal billing accounts; that will add a monthly reconciliation step.
- Net45: we will record Net45 as the billing term in the customer profile and in the SOW.

Ben — please draft the SOW with the Net45 term, prepay discount tiers Sergio mentioned, and an exception clause for interim overage invoices. Karhtik — if ERP mapping or GL code mapping is required, let us know what format ProcureWell expects (CSV mapping or EDI?).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: SOW_ProcureWell_v1.docx (docx)

From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@procurewell.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap.procure@procurewell.com>, Procurement Legal <contracts@procurewell.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:31:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing cadence, PO fields, and prepay discount questions

Thanks Marissa — that all sounds workable. A few clarifications from our side:

- Tax ID: 94-2231146. Please print exactly as "Tax ID: 94-2231146" in the header.
- Contract# format: prefer "PW-2026-118" (with the dash).
- Split remittance: we need two payable invoices issued to separate cost centers (not a remittance note). Our AP system cannot ingest split notes. If Redwood requires separate billing accounts for that, we can provide internal GL allocations and a single master PO that references two billing account numbers.
- Interim invoices: acceptable for overage events. We will require the SOW to list thresholds that trigger interim billing (e.g., >20% above forecasted monthly usage).

Can you provide a sample monthly consolidated invoice with two payable invoices (one per cost center) so our AP team can validate with ERP? If separate payable invoices requires additional integration, please quote any one-time effort.

Lina

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: lina.gomez@procurewell.com, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing cadence, PO fields, and prepay discount questions

Hi Lina — thanks for the details. Quick summary and commitments from Redwood:

- We will include "Tax ID: 94-2231146" and the exact Contract wording you requested on every invoice PDF and the invoice XML payload.
- We support issuing two payable invoices per month tied to a single master PO. That requires us to set up two billing accounts; one-time setup fee: $750 (one-off), estimated implementation and QA 3 business days.
- Prepay discount tiers: confirmed (3% at $150k, 6% at $350k, 10% at $750k). Discount will be applied pro rata across the separate payable invoices based on allocation schedule you provide.
- Net45 will be recorded in the SOW and customer profile.
- Invoice retention: we will retain invoice PDFs and invoice XML for 7 years in our billing archive.

Next steps:
1) Lina — please confirm you approve the $750 one-time setup fee for two-billable-invoices and send the master PO with the two internal billing account numbers.
2) Sergio/Marissa — I'll update the SOW and push to DocuSign with the Net45 term and the interim invoice threshold clause (20% over forecast).

If approved, we can go live for the December 1 billing cycle.

Best,
Ben Carter
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
